title: Fluff Pack
description: The ultimate Modpack for brutal FPS and the best Vanilla-Plus experience. Fully optimized and 100% safe for SMPs
body:
# 🚀 Welcome to Fluff Pack!
Fluff Pack is the ultimate, hyper-optimized Minecraft modpack tailored specifically for the Fluff Community. It combines competitive PvP optimizations, breathtaking visual enhancements, and next-generation performance mods to deliver the best Minecraft experience possible without bloating your game. You can play safe unn eyery SMP like HugoSMP!

## 🔥 Key Features & Mod Highlights
### ⚔️ Competitive PvP Features

Dominate every fight with tools designed for flawless combat and crystal-fast updates:

**Marlow's Crystal Optimizer:** Ultra-smooth crystal placement and optimization for competitive mechanics.

**Totem Counter & Totem Tweaks:** Keep perfect track of your enemy's resources and manage yours with a custom, clean interface.

**BetterHurtCam & Shield Statuses:** Clear visual cues during battle without cluttering your screen.

**uku's Armor HUD:** Real-time durability and gear tracking so you never get caught off guard.

**Zoomify:** Smooth, customizable cinematic zoom to spot enemies from afar.

### 🌅 Visual Enhancements

Make your world look absolutely stunning while maintaining top-tier gameplay:

**Distant Horizons**: Enjoy jaw-dropping, endless render distances using advanced level-of-detail (LOD) graphics.

**Iris Shaders:** Fully integrated, high-performance shader support to give your game beautiful lighting and shadows.

**3D Skin Layers & Capes:** See player skins and custom capes rendered in gorgeous, immersive 3D.

**Falling Leaves:** Immersive particle effects that make forests feel alive.

### ⚡ Next-Gen Performance & FPS Boosts

Say goodbye to lag spikes. This pack uses a cutting-edge optimization stack:

**Sodium & Lithium:** The gold standard for modern rendering and game logic performance.

**ImmediatelyFast:** Hyper-optimized entity and text rendering to keep your frame rates exceptionally high in crowded areas.

**Entity Culling & Dynamic FPS:** Intelligently stops rendering what you can't see, saving massive computer resources.

**FerriteCore:** Dramatically reduces Minecraft's memory (RAM) usage.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life & Social

**Simple Voice Chat:** Proximity voice chat to coordinate with your team natively in-game.

**Essential Mod:** Easily invite friends to your world, share cosmetics, and stay connected.

**AppleSkin & Shulker Box Tooltip:** Instantly see food values and inspect container contents without placing them down.
